name: go-sqlite3-replay-verified-window-aggregate-719d
instr:
go-sqlite3 cannot detect or repair corrupted window-aggregate callback state from the active SQL frame. Add opt-in, connection-scoped replay verification with disabled, detect-only, and repair modes and a deterministic interval. Preserve SQLite-visible values and errors, and continue from fully reconstructed state.

Enabled `WindowReplayPolicy` values require positive `Interval`; `WindowReplayDisabled` permits zero. Preserve registration flags, results, cleanup, and connection initialization. Retain independent copies of Step arguments. After successful Inverse, remove the oldest logically matching row. Verify only after completed mutations at the interval, never exposing partial reconstruction.

`WindowReplayResult` captures nulls, errors, storage class, subtype, and payload without changing Value results. Compare type and floating-point bits, treating all NaNs as equivalent. Every replayable statistic, including every, some, mode, scalar and list percentile, covariance, regression, and moment functions, must reconstruct independent native typed state from the active frame, unaffected by Value mutations. Preserve null, empty, singleton, tie, promotion, arity, result-shape, and error-classification behavior.

`ReplayableWindowFunction` extends `WindowFunction` with `Replay(WindowReplayFrame) (WindowFunction, error)`. Repair replaces live state only after successful reconstruction and comparison, returning `WindowReplayReport`. Otherwise `WindowReplayMismatch` retains determin
